caseName: Nashville, Chattanooga & St. Louis Railway v. Henry
caseNameFull: Nashville, Chattanooga & St. Louis Railway, in Error v. Toy Henry
summary: In error to the Court of Appeals of the State of Kentucky.
attorneys: Mr. D. H. Hughes and Mr. Charles K. Wheeler for plaintiff in error., Mr. Samuel A. Anderson for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed with costs and 5 per cent,

damages upon the authority of Chicago Junction Ry. Co. v. King, 222 U. S. 222; Seaboard Air Line Ry. v. Padgett, 236 U. S. 668; Baltimore & Ohio R. R. Co. v. Whitacre, 242 U. S. 169.
